lab.code:
# 国王的麦粒探索台：每格翻倍
n = 10   # 棋盘格数

hide()
p = 1
i = 0
while i < n:
    p = p * 2
    col = 40 + i * 16
    h = p / p * 10 + i * 7
    if h > 150:
        h = 150
    pen_color("blue")
    pen_down()
    go_to(col - 200, -120)
    go_to(col - 200, -120 + h)
    go_to(col - 188, -120 + h)
    go_to(col - 188, -120)
    go_to(col - 200, -120)
    pen_up()
    i = i + 1
write("第 " + n + " 格 = " + p + " 粒", -190, 130, "red", 13)
write("柱子越高=麦粒越多（每格翻倍）", -190, 150, "blue", 11)
